answer: The strongest lever is simple: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because forge only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. In practice lantern is enforced by the ledger itself: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any tundra approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
